marks.label: Permanent failure
marks.text: Below 3.0 V per cell for 10 s the gas gauge locks the pack out for good (a permanent failure). The notes aim this at a pack left on a shelf too long: it is charging a pack this flat that is dangerous.
marks.line: - Threshold: 3.0V (Absolute minimum according to maxamps spec sheet)

marks.label: Empty: output off
marks.text: Cell undervoltage. Below 3.2 V per cell (16 V for the pack, MaxAmps' recommended cutoff) for 2 s the BMS turns the output off. It stays off until the pack is charged past 3.5 V per cell.
marks.line: - Hard stop discharge at 3.2V for 2 seconds

marks.label: Swap packs
marks.text: Swap the packs by 17.5 V (3.5 V per cell, MaxAmps' recommended landing voltage). The gauge sets its terminate-discharge alarm flag here, meant as "the alert for software to swap battery", but nothing on Talos reads or shows it. Watch balanced_voltage in state/electrical or the voltage in the ESC telemetry instead.
marks.line: - Maxamps recommends landing voltage of 17.5V, so we'll set the alert for software to swap battery

marks.label: Diagnostics warning
marks.text: battery_volt.warn in diagnostic_thresholds.yaml. The diagnostics node is no longer run, but the pre-test checks reuse 18.5 V as the minimum bus voltage on batteries.

marks.label: Nominal
marks.text: Design voltage of the 5S pack: 3.7 V per cell. Capacity is quoted at this voltage: 8 Ah x 18.5 V = 148 Wh.

marks.label: Charged
marks.text: The notes give 4.15 V per cell as the charge voltage, a little under the 4.2 V maximum.

marks.label: Overvoltage
marks.text: Cell overvoltage protection at 4.2 V per cell (the cell datasheet maximum). Charging resumes only after the cells fall below 4.0 V.
marks.line: - Above 4.2V we'll overvoltage (according to battery datasheet)

pack.line: Designed for MaxAmps 8000 mAh 5S2P 18.5V LiPo battery pack

discharge_oc.line: - Slower limit at 45A (fuse rating) for 5 seconds

discharge_peak.line: - Faster limit at 80A for 2 seconds (peak current draw)

charge_oc.line: - Max charge current @5A - limited by charging fuse on board

ot_discharge.line: - 60 degC discharge max @2s 55C recovery (max operating according to batt datasheet)

ot_charge.line: - 50 degC charging max @2s 45 degC recovery (datasheet doesn't give max charge)

zero_volt_charge.line: - Below 2.9V, we won't let the battery charge anymore

auto_ship.line: - We'll enter shutdown if the pack isn't touched for 1 week

fuse_off.line: - 0 No fuse right now (keeping off until we're done with robosub at least)

pf_rs24.line: - Once we know that PF won't accidentally fire on us (give it a few months after robosub 2024) **IT DID AT RS24**
